data.description:
At xneelo, it starts with purpose. We’re business enablers offering a hosting service for our customers to create and transact online. We spend each day working hard to retain the trust of our customers. Inspired by our brand promise ‘trusted in hosting’, we deliver a web hosting service that is reliable and consistent, focusing on infrastructure stability, good value and consistent service delivery.

A large scale, mass-market hosting infrastructure is a complex beast requiring quality automation and processes to make sure it can scale and perform optimally, 24x7x365.

Product development at xneelo looks to the engineering of the backend infrastructure as a vital component of being able to delight our customers - by being part of transforming complexity into click-of-a-button simplicity.

We are passionate about frequent, iterative delivery of high-quality software and aim to build lasting solutions using Agile principles and the latest technology available.

We work together in autonomous teams that take full responsibility for their own part of the xneelo ecosystem and require an understanding of the Agile development philosophy.

Like what you hear? Well, let’s break it down:

Basically, you will be involved in

  • Full-stack development with a passion for end-to-end development and ownership across the stack, with a particular interest and strength in front-end development.

  • Solving interesting and large-scale backend technical challenges

  • Being part of figuring out how we get better at what we do

  • Looking for opportunities to innovate and optimize

  • Understanding the needs of the customer in order to deliver innovative, robust solutions (In collaboration with the Product Owner and stakeholders, of course)

  • Supporting the customer from an operational perspective when escalated by the Client Services team

You probably have a passion for

  • Programming, open-source technologies, and IT in general

  • Optimal systems and simple procedures

  • Agile development and a self-organizing team environment

  • Sharing ideas and innovation

Requirements

You have a passion for

  • Design & development of backend software and APIs

  • Front-end development (React, Angular or Vue)

  • Object-oriented programming using a language like Ruby

  • Software development within the Linux/Unix environment

  • Software development using a containerization platform like Docker or Kubernetes

  • Agile development practices (team focus, continual improvement, automated tests, refactoring, continuous integration, pair programming)

  • Effective communication

  • Self-motivation and self-management

  • Life-Long Learning

Your qualifications include

  • BSc majoring in Computer Science will be advantageous, however, your ability to demonstrate your track record of writing quality backend software is what ultimately counts

  • A minimum of 4+ years of software development experience

  • Minimum of 2 years supporting a large scale application in an operational capacity

If your experience includes the following, it would be great

  • Thinking like a hacker and diving into the security details of the software you’ve built

  • Experience with Rancher, Docker Swarm or other container orchestration platforms

  • Understanding of database design and performance tuning (MySQL, Redis, etc.)

  • Experience with DevOps on a linux based platform

  • Experience with system administration on a linux based platform

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
About us:
Foodsmart is the leading telenutrition and foodcare solution, backed by a robust network of Registered Dietitians. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver long-term health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide our 2.2 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG's Rise Fund to help expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

Our core values:

👥 Customer First — You start with the member and work backwards.

🚀 Make It Happen — You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.

🤝 One Team — You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

About the role:
Foodsmart's Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) team builds the telenutrition and foodcare platform used by members, providers, and partners. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow an engineering organization of approximately 16 engineers, setting technical direction and management practices that keep the team shipping reliable, high-quality software. You'll partner closely with product and design to translate roadmap priorities into well-architected systems, champion the adoption of AI throughout our engineering practices, and raise the bar on our full-stack web platform.

You will

  • Lead AI-native development: Bring strong, hands-on AI experience to guide teams building AI-native software products architected around AI from the ground up spanning agentic workflows, LLM-powered services, and AI-assisted engineering practices, not just AI-adjacent features.
  • Own four AI pods end to end: Directly manage four AI-focused pods, each accountable for delivering specific features and outcomes. You own execution, delivery, quality, and velocity across all four.
  • Manage cross-pod dependencies and risk: Identify where pods' roadmaps intersect, sequence work to avoid bottlenecks, and proactively surface and mitigate risks before they threaten delivery.
  • Shape architecture: Participate in and help drive architecture reviews across our React.js/TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, PostgreSQL, and Redshift stack, ensuring decisions hold up for scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability, including in a HIPAA/SOC 2-aware environment.
  • Stay outcome-focused: Keep teams anchored to member and business impact rather than pure output, helping them prioritize the work that moves the needle.
  • Champion AI adoption: Drive the practical use of AI across engineering from AI-assisted development tooling to AI-powered product features, keeping the org current with emerging tools and practices.
  • Drive engineering excellence: Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, incident response, and CI/CD practices across the pods.
  • Mentor and develop talent: Coach engineers and tech leads at all levels, building the next generation of technical leadership inside the org.
  • Communicate and collaborate: Act as a clear, consistent communicator and trusted partner across engineering, product, design, and leadership, translating technical realities for non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.

You are

  • A people-first, hands-on leader who invests in coaching engineers at every level and has led organizations of a similar size (10+ engineers).
  • A systems thinker who brings clarity to ambiguity, balances speed against risk, and earns trust across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Calm under pressure, with crisp written, verbal, and executive communication, and comfortable making and documenting decisions.
  • Genuinely curious about AI, with real interest in its application to both engineering workflows and product development , not just familiarity with the term.
  • Highly adaptable, quick to pivot as priorities shift, consistently responsive, and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • An outcome-driven operator who ties engineering decisions back to measurable business and member impact.

You have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams, with a track record leading 10+ engineers (startup or high-growth environment preferred).
  • Strong, hands-on AI-native development experience building products with agentic systems, LLM integrations, or AI-first architectures and a track record applying AI to both engineering workflows and product features.
  • A proven track record managing multiple engineering teams simultaneously, with clear accountability for delivery, quality, and velocity.
  • Experience managing cross-team dependencies and risk in a fast-moving, multi-pod environment.
  • Experience running engineering delivery with Agile/Lean practices (Scrum/Kanban) using tools like Jira and Confluence.
  • A track record of setting technical direction and making sound architecture decisions for scalable, full-stack web applications.
  • Deep working knowledge of our core stack: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, SQS,
  • DynamoDB), PostgreSQL, and Redshift, along with Docker/Kubernetes for containerized, orchestrated deployments, and familiarity with GraphQL and RESTful API design.
  • A strong outcome/value-oriented mindset, with a track record of tying engineering work to business impact.
  • Excellent mentorship and coaching skills, with genuine investment in developing people.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in regulated environments (healthcare/digital health preferred), with HIPAA/SOC 2 awareness and audit-friendly change management, is a plus.

    • Tools we use:

    Jira, Confluence, Cursor, Figma, Google Workspace, Loom, AWS, PostgreSQL, Redshift, modern CI/CD and observability tooling.

OUR BENEFITS & PERKS

🏠 Remote-First Culture — Work from anywhere with a flexible schedule.
🏝️ Unlimited PTO — We prioritize rest and recharging.
🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare — Robust medical, dental, and vision coverage.
💰 Financial Wellness — 401k & performance bonuses
🥗 Personalized Nutrition — Access to our network of Registered Dietitians.

Foodsmart is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-manager-software-engineering-foodsmart

Job Title: Senior AI/Backend Engineer

Location: Remote – Latin America Preferred (Must overlap with U.S. time zones)

Type of Contract: Full-Time | Remote

Salary Range: Market Rates

Language Requirements: Professional English proficiency

We are seeking a skilled Senior AI/Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Python, AI orchestration, and cloud-native backend systems to join our growing team. You will play a key role in developing a scalable, production-ready AI Voice Dispatch Assistant operating entirely within a secure AWS environment. Your work will directly impact the reliability, intelligence, and scalability of a multi-agent voice AI platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain a multi-agent AI system using Strands Agents SDK (BidiAgent) deployed on AWS ECS/Fargate, ensuring per-session isolation, auto-scaling, and lifecycle management of Nova 2 Sonic BidirectionalStream.
  • Develop and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs using FastAPI, including centralized API client libraries for Member Services, Dispatch, Coverage, and Eligibility workflows.
  • Build robust backend features such as Pydantic-based data models, field-level PII masking, audit logging, and endpoint-level caching strategies.
  • Implement LLM orchestration and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including triage super-agent routing using Nova Micro and specialized sub-agent delegation.
  • Integrate AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch Serverless, and Titan embeddings to ground AI responses using technical documentation and domain-specific knowledge.
  • Configure security, compliance, and content protection controls, including Bedrock Guardrails, AWS Cognito authentication, FastAPI JWT middleware, and Lambda-based authorization mechanisms.
  • Develop and manage serverless infrastructure components including API Gateway, AWS Lambda handlers, DynamoDB session state management, and ElastiCache Redis integrations.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of senior-level software engineering experience with a strong focus on Python development.
  • Extensive experience building scalable, resilient backend systems and APIs, preferably using FastAPI.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with AI/ML concepts, including LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Deep knowledge of AWS services including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and AWS Bedrock services such as Nova 2 Sonic and Nova Micro.
  • Experience with multi-agent AI architecture frameworks such as Strands Agents SDK or similar technologies.
  • Solid understanding of authentication, security, and compliance best practices, including PII handling, prompt-injection protection, and access control systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams while maintaining consistent overlap with U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building production-grade voice AI or conversational AI systems.
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch Serverless, Titan embeddings, and AWS-native RAG implementations.
  • Experience designing secure, enterprise-grade AI solutions within controlled cloud environments.
  • Background working with healthcare, dispatch, or operational workflow automation platforms.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-aibackend-engineer-nearshore-business-solutions

data.description:
※後半に日本語の説明があります

C# software engineering position in a highly-growing startup, developing a document IDE for non-engineers.

About BoostDraft

BoostDraft is a software engineering company that develops IDE for documents. It was founded by MIT and Stanford grad students, developing an assisted document editor for documents. It is a new document editor that employs error checking, reference checking and auto-completion using both rule-based approach and NLP, like what coding editors/IDE (e.g. VSCode, Pycharm) do.

Please find more information here:

Background & Traction

We are currently focusing on Lawyers who draft relatively standardized but long documents, such as contracts. With only four years after our product launch, we already have more than 10,000 active paid users. We have several long-term, large-scale contracts with famed enterprises and law firms. As a result, we achieved significant success, including profitability and exponential growth, all without relying on external funding for nearly four years.

BoostDraft was accepted by prestigious accelerator program, MassChallenge (Top 30 US accelerator), StartX (Stanford Accelerator, 7% acceptance rate), MIT Sandbox (Accelerator of Massachusetts Institute of Technology)

Join our Engineering-First Team

At BoostDraft, we prioritize quality over quantity. As an engineering-first company. Around 50-60% of our team members are software engineers with extensive experiences from companies such as Microsoft, IBM, HTC, Yahoo!, and R&D in NTT.

Technical Challenges We Solve

  • Performance improvement using both partial analysis and full analysis
  • Synchronization between user input and on-memory text
  • Cache efficiency to increase highlight performance t during/after user input
  • Security preserving Natural Language Processing, such as Federated Learning

What’s your challenge

As a C# Software Engineer at BoostDraft, you will be tackling challenging technical problems, including:

  • Design and implement classes and methods for IDE for documents
  • Refactor existing code for better extensibility
  • Interview with our users to understand their daily work and pain points
  • Propose both innovative ideas and feasible ideas to achieve unprecedented features

【Languages】 C#,（partially）Rust, Python

【FW】.NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【DB】 SQLite, Amazon RDS

【Log Analysis】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

Ensuring a Fair and Secure Recruitment Process:

In recent years, there has been a growing number of applications submitted with fake or AI-generated profiles, including fabricated work history or impersonated identities. At BoostDraft, we are committed to providing a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates and have implemented the following measures:

  • During online interviews, the use of both camera and microphone is mandatory. If we detect suspicious behavior, we may ask you to disable video filters or perform a simple on-screen action. If you are unable or unwilling to comply, the interview may be terminated on the spot.
  • By applying for a position or participating in an interview, you are deemed to have agreed to these measures and to cooperate if such requests are reasonably made.

These measures are applied equally to all candidates to ensure a trustworthy and fair hiring environment. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

If you have any concerns or questions regarding these measures, please feel free to contact our recruiting team.

事業内容

弊社はVS CodeやIntelli J等のIDEのコンセプトを法務文書領域に適用した、支援機能付きドキュメントエディタの開発を行っております。

ソフトウェア開発者がIDEのさまざまな支援機能によって本質的なコーディングに集中できている事実に着想を得て、法律文書に特化した同様の支援機能をMicrosoft Wordのアドインとして実装することで、ユーザが法務文書作成時の本質的な作業に注力できるようにするものです。顧客の大半は弁護士事務所および企業法務部で、大規模・中規模弁護士事務所はほぼすべて、多数の大企業に導入していただいております。そして、創業からすぐに高い収益を上げたことから、約四年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

権威のあるアクセラレータープログラムである、MassChallenge (米国トップ30アクセラレータ)、StartX (スタンフォードアクセラレータ、採択率7%)、MIT Sandbox (マサチューセッツ工科大学アクセラレータ)に受け入れられてきた実績があります。

会社紹介資料:

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • プロダクト開発を中心とした組織作り
    • CEOのSeanをはじめとし、社員の約5割がエンジニア職で構成されており、各メンバーはMicrosoft, IBM, HTC, LINEヤフー, NTT研究所などの有力企業で経験を積んでいます。
  • 研究開発への投資
    • IDEの概念を応用し、バージョン管理・比較、パッケージ管理、プラグイン等、他のソフトウェアとの連携・拡張を実現する予定です。
  • 事業の成長性
    • 創業一年目から継続して黒字経営を行っているなど、日系スタートアップの中では稀な成長の軌跡を達成しています。すでに米国や韓国をはじめとした国外でも事業を展開しています。

私たちが解決する技術的課題:

  • 部分的解析と全体解析の両方を活用したパフォーマンスの向上
  • ユーザーの入力とオンメモリのテキスト間の同期
  • ユーザー入力中や入力後のハイライトのパフォーマンスを向上させるためのキャッシュ効率化
  • 連合学習（フェデレーテッド・ラーニング）など、セキュリティを保護しながら行う自然言語処理

業務内容:

C# ソフトウェアエンジニアとして、以下の技術的課題を解決いただきます：

・C＃を活用したクラス・インターフェース設計および実装

・拡張性を高めるための既存コードの再設計

・ユニットテスト記述
・効果的なアルゴリズムの開発
・チームメンバーが開発したコードのレビュー
・全体アーキテクチャ設計・技術選定
・顧客インタビューを通じた機能の詳細化
・新たな機能を実装するための革新的かつ実現可能なアイディアの提案

・心理的安全性の高い環境の構築

スキル・志向に応じて

・機能の優先順位付け

・エンジニアの採用

・チームメンバーへの指導・メンタリング

【言語】 C#,（一部）Rust, Python

【FW】 .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【DB】 SQLite, Amazon RDS

【ログ分析】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

その他記事:

採用プロセスにおける本人確認と不正防止の取り組みについて:

近年、AI技術を活用した偽装プロフィール（架空の経歴や人物）による応募が国内外で増加しています。BoostDraftでは、すべての候補者に公平で安全な採用プロセスを提供するため、以下の対策を講じています。

  • オンライン面接では、カメラとマイクの使用を必須とさせていただき、不審な挙動が見られた場合には映像フィルターの無効化や簡単な操作のご協力をお願いすることがあります。ご協力いただけない場合は、面接をその場で中止させていただくことがあります。
  • 応募または面接にご参加いただいた時点で、当社が必要と判断した場合にこれらの対応をお願いする可能性があることに同意いただいたものとみなします。

これらの取り組みは、すべての候補者の方にとって安心・公正な選考環境を保つためのものであり、一律に適用されます。ご理解とご協力をお願いいたします。

conditions.details: Shift: U.S. Eastern Time 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Philippine Time 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM during U.S. Daylight Saving Time, or 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM during U.S. Standard Time.

data.description:
Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • U.S. Eastern Time: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Philippine Time:

    • 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM (during U.S. Daylight Saving Time)

    • 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM (during U.S. Standard Time)

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

data.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong.

If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others).

  • Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.

  • Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging.

  • Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities.

  • Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers.

  • Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling.

  • Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability.

  • Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems.

  • Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana).

  • Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus.

  • Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity.

  • High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation.

  • Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality.

  • Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development.

  • A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Bank Infrastructure and work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, finance operations, compliance, and other engineering squads within Pleo's Payments organisation. Bank Infrastructure is foundational to nearly everything Pleo does, your work will have direct dependencies with and from Card Infrastructure, Credit, and beyond. You'll collaborate with partners across the business to shape how Pleo moves money reliably at scale.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first six months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's payment rail architecture, understanding how inbound and outbound bank payment flows are built, monitored, and operated.

  • Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in the bank integration or payment operations domain and drive them from design to production.

  • Build relationships across the engineering organisation, contributing to code reviews and technical discussions beyond your immediate team.

  • Grow your expertise in high-reliability, mission-critical financial infrastructure while contributing to Pleo's broader engineering culture.

We're committed to supporting your growth, whether through expanding your payment systems expertise, stepping into broader architectural influence, or taking on technical leadership responsibilities as Pleo scales.

Show me the benefits!

Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍ We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Coding Interview (Multiple choice)

  3. System Design (whiteboarding session)

  4. Engineering Mananeer Behavioural Interview

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received hundreds of applicants but could only speak with so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead - NetBox Delivery
data.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Delivery, a new team in our Applications group.

NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Delivery owns everything between a NetBox Core release and a healthy, running instance on Cloud and Enterprise. We work closely with NetBox Core, the team that builds NetBox and its core plugins. We ship the software, keep an eye on it in production, and when something breaks, we fix it at the source rather than working around it.

As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Delivery and write much of its code. You bring strong software engineering skills, SaaS experience, and hands-on DevOps and Kubernetes skills. You will be one of the first engineers on this team and help shape how it works.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build the software that installs, upgrades, and runs NetBox, such as Kubernetes operators, controllers, internal APIs, and release tooling

  • Contribute to NetBox and its core plugins, in collaboration with NetBox Core, to make them faster and more reliable in production, from application startup to Postgres query performance

  • Build observability into the software the team owns, and set the team's standards for testing, documentation, and SLOs

  • Own the technical direction and architecture for how NetBox is built, released, and run on Cloud and Enterprise, as the team's primary technical decision maker

  • Lead and mentor the team's engineers, including its SRE, through design and code review

  • Work with NetBox Core and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to define release contracts and drive cross-team changes through RFCs

  • Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area

  • Strong Python skills and experience with production SaaS applications; Django and Postgres preferred

  • Experience building software on top of Kubernetes, such as operators, controllers, or deployment tooling, with a solid understanding of reconciliation loops, custom resources, and the Kubernetes API

  • Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging, with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Sentry

  • Hands-on experience with several tools in our delivery stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Helm, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD, Terraform, and Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority, including mentoring other engineers

  • Hands-on experience building inside an AI-augmented development harness, including Claude Code and the workflows that make agentic tooling reliable

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity and driving work across team boundaries, from writing the RFC to getting a cross-team migration done

Nice to haves:

  • Rust or Go programming experience

  • Production experience with Django and Postgres at scale, including schema design, migration risk, and query performance

  • Familiarity with the NetBox ecosystem or network automation

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization

  • Open source contributions or project involvement

  • Experience with self-managed or on-premises delivery

  • Container build skills, including base image design and Python dependency management

  • Experience with supply chain security, such as vulnerability scanning, image signing and SOC 2 controls for build pipelines

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.

What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.

How you work:

  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

data.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

The Role

We are looking for engineers who are excited to be part of our early story and help us build a diverse and vibrant company. As a senior software engineer you will have the opportunity to work across the entire stack with a focus on the back-end. You will have the opportunity to learn and drive the creation of financial products and experiences to help our customers reach their full potential. You should have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking projects from inception to release. As an early employee, you’ll be working with a nimble team of committed and talented engineers and having a large, long-term impact on technical design and engineering culture.

We are open to candidates from Canada, the United States, and Colombia.

What You’ll Do

  • Ownership over large domains and features related to card processing/issuing, and core ledgering of financial transactions
  • Play a critical role in the development, design, and maintenance of Flex's platform and services.
  • Architect well thought-out services and data models that ensure Flex's continued growth
  • Own problems end-to-end, thinking through everything from api contracts, data, scalability, security, observability, and metrics.
  • Lead by example and mentor engineers in all aspects of planning, development and testing.
  • Be a catalyst for driving best-in-class technology frameworks and tooling while staying engaged with the latest technology trends.
  • Be on call, with the expectation to ability to solve problems and find solutions for the servicing team

What You Need

  • Proficiency in NodeJS+Typescript and server design principles.
  • An understanding and interest in architectural patterns for highly available, scalable, low-latency, asynchronous systems
  • Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards.
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to provide in-depth evaluation of multiple technical directions and determine tradeoffs of each.
  • Strong propensity to make data-driven decisions on technical architecture and project prioritization.
  • Exposure to modular monoliths and micro-services along with the benefits and challenges they bring.
  • Experience with any cloud based provider like Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
  • Four or more years of relevant industry experience with a track record of shipping high-quality products and features at scale.
  • A strong work ethic and are ready to grind
  • Have built and shipped a working project or product, ideally something complex

Compensation

Additional Information

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

data.title: Senior Security Engineering Manager
data.description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Security Engineering Leader to help make security engineering more effective, scalable, and repeatable as Brain Co. grows. You’ll report to the Head of Security and serve as a close partner in leading the function.

Brain Co. works with sensitive customer data in a high-stakes environment with very low tolerance for risk. This is a player-coach role: you’ll set direction, develop leaders, improve how the team operates, and stay close enough to the technical work to guide difficult decisions.

The initial scope is intentionally focused and expected to grow through results. The right person is comfortable building in a greenfield environment, creating high ownership, and translating security risk into clear priorities for technical and non-technical partners. The mandate from day one is to develop people, improve execution, and make disciplined choices about the risks and systems that matter most.

What You’ll Lead & Build

  • Set and refine the security engineering roadmap in partnership with company and engineering leadership.

  • Automate and operationalize how security engineering engages with the rest of the company.

  • Strengthen existing SLAs, KPIs, ownership models, and operating rhythms, then use them to improve velocity and security outcomes.

  • Drive operational excellence across security engineering domains, including vulnerability management, application and infrastructure security, incident response, monitoring, and automation.

  • Turn effective security engineering practices into a repeatable system that scales beyond individual heroics.

  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team; develop managers and technical leaders through clear expectations, feedback, and mentorship.

  • Translate strategy into team priorities, individual goals, and an accountable execution plan.

  • Stay hands-on in technical decisions, architecture review, code review, and implementation when the work requires it.

  • Partner across engineering and product to embed security into the software development lifecycle and make the secure path the practical path.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience managing managers and developing leaders at multiple levels.

  • Hands-on security engineering leadership and the ability to build a function in a zero-to-one environment.

  • Broad knowledge across multiple security domains—such as vulnerability management, incident response, security monitoring, application security, or cloud security—with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A player-coach track record: able to guide technical design and execution while managing people, priorities, and processes.

  • Strong prioritization judgment when the scope is broad and the tolerance for risk is low.

  • Experience improving how a team operates, including how work is measured, assigned, and delivered.

  • Experience automating a security team’s engagement model or improving its SLA and KPI practices.

  • Experience turning strategy into roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and cross-functional execution.

  • Strong communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the ability to articulate business risk and secure alignment.

  • A track record of hiring, coaching, mentoring, and raising the performance of technical teams and leaders.

Experience in a SaaS or AI company with low risk thresholds, or building security infrastructure, monitoring, and automation, is helpful but not required.clients who may be skeptical of or unfamiliar with the tooling.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision (100% Coverage)

  • Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave

  • 401(k)

  • Daily Lunches + Dinners

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Brain Co. is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs - contact talent@braincompany.ai to request one.

Ready to build with us?

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments
data.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong.

If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others).

  • Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.

  • Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging.

  • Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities.

  • Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers.

  • Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling.

  • Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability.

  • Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems.

  • Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana).

  • Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus.

  • Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity.

  • High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation.

  • Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality.

  • Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development.

  • A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Bank Infrastructure and work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, finance operations, compliance, and other engineering squads within Pleo's Payments organisation. Bank Infrastructure is foundational to nearly everything Pleo does, your work will have direct dependencies with and from Card Infrastructure, Credit, and beyond. You'll collaborate with partners across the business to shape how Pleo moves money reliably at scale.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first six months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's payment rail architecture, understanding how inbound and outbound bank payment flows are built, monitored, and operated.

  • Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in the bank integration or payment operations domain and drive them from design to production.

  • Build relationships across the engineering organisation, contributing to code reviews and technical discussions beyond your immediate team.

  • Grow your expertise in high-reliability, mission-critical financial infrastructure while contributing to Pleo's broader engineering culture.

We're committed to supporting your growth, whether through expanding your payment systems expertise, stepping into broader architectural influence, or taking on technical leadership responsibilities as Pleo scales.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Coding Interview (Multiple choice)

  3. System Design (whiteboarding session)

  4. Engineering Mananeer Behavioural Interview

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received hundreds of applicants but could only speak with so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

data.description:
About the Role

Hinge Health is a digital health company focused on delivering evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. By combining personalized exercise therapy with virtual care, Hinge Health helps people manage and reduce chronic pain while improving quality of life and reducing healthcare costs.

The Financial Systems team builds and operates the billing and financial infrastructure that powers how Hinge Health makes money. Our systems support the movement of revenue-critical data across products, payers, and internal financial workflows. As Hinge Health expands into new products such as HingeSelect, introduces more complex payment models, adds multi-payer integrations, and grows globally, we need engineers who can build systems that are correct, observable, secure, and resilient at scale.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is excited to work on high-impact financial systems where correctness and reliability matter. You will help design the technical foundations for billing and financial workflows, improve the traceability of money-related data, and make it easier for our product, operations, and Finance partners to deliver a seamless experience for members and customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes a systems-thinking approach to problems involving data integrity, integrations, operational workflows, and long-term maintainability. You care about the details, understand the customer impact of financial systems, and take ownership from design through production operation.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested and performant APIs, and durable data models. You will profile systems to stay ahead of scaling bottlenecks, participate in thoughtful and constructive code reviews, and help maintain a high engineering bar.

We practice continuous deployment and expect owner-operators to support the systems they build in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance posture reflects the standards required for healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects across billing and financial workflows, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Design and evolve reliable services, APIs, and data models for revenue-critical systems, including billing flows, payment-model changes, payer integrations, and financial data movement.

  • Build for correctness and traceability by establishing clear data ownership, durable workflows, idempotent processing, strong validation, and actionable audit and operational signals.

  • Break down complex, cross-functional problems into manageable tasks, enabling steady delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents and data discrepancies.

  • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Data, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, roadmap technical strategy, and balance short-term delivery with long-term system health.

  • Improve the maintainability, availability, performance, and observability of financial systems, including developer tooling and operational runbooks.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and knowledge sharing.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners, and document decisions and workflows so they remain understandable as the team grows.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate engineering and operational processes and enhance product capabilities, while preserving appropriate review and control for financial workflows.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

  • 2+ years of experience with at least one programming language.

  • 2+ years of experience across the full software development life cycle, from design through production support.

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Golang, Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous or distributed workflows.

  • Experience working with relational databases and integrations where data integrity, failure handling, and observability are important.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building billing, payments, revenue, accounting, claims, or other financial systems.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and scalable cloud services.

  • Experience with Golang, Python, gRPC, Postgres, Redis, Temporal, AWS\

  • Experience improving data quality, operational visibility, incident response, or developer tooling for critical systems.

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers.

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design, coding assistance, or process automation.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

  • mahdollisuuden kehittää ja laajentaa osaamistasi mielenkiintoisten ja merkityksellisten projektien parissa

  • oman, kehittyvän integraatioalustan Frendsin, joka on saanut tunnustusta kansainvälisessä Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ -tutkimuksessa

Erikoisuutenamme on oma integraatioalustamme Frends, jota käytämme useimmiten projekteissamme. Frends on täysin suomalainen low-code, hybridi-integraatioalusta. Tuotteen tuoreimmassa inkarnaatiossa käytetään moderneja teknologioita ja pilvipalveluita. Frends on pohjautuu C#:iin ja pyörii Azuren päällä.

Tuntemus API-arkkitehtuureista, API Managementista, GraphQL:stä ja LINQ:sta ovat asioita, joita arvostamme - ja joita pääset myös oppimaan.

🧐 Frendszone

Lyhyesti kuvattuna, olemme IT-konsulttitalo ja palvelemme hyvin monenlaisia asiakkaita laidasta laitaan niin yksityisellä kuin julkisella sektorilla ja useilla eri toimialoilla.

Frendsissä on noin 250 asiantuntijaa, joista reilu 170 toimii omissa pienkonsulttitiimeissämme. Tiimeissä on kehittäjiä, arkkitehtejä, palvelupäälliköitä ja projektipäälliköitä. Osa kehittäjistä on keskittynyt täysin kehitystyöhön, osa tekee tämän lisäksi esimerkiksi määrittelyä, kouluttamista tai myynnin tukea. Kuuntelemme tekijöitämme ja pyrimme muokkaamaan roolia ja urapolkua jokaiselle mieluisaksi.

➡️FAQ-blogissa vastaamme yleisimpiin kysymyksiin, joita keskusteluissa on herännyt. Arjestamme voit myös lukea lisää täältä. Arvoista ja kulttuuristamme kerromme lisää täällä. Tutustu blogiimme miksi talentit valitsevat Frendsin ja miksi meillä viihdytään.

⭐ Miten edetään?

Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.

Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .

Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

  • Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

  • Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

data.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database Administrator to provide enterprise-wide leadership of database operations supporting a major federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role oversees secure hosting of IL5-compliant database platforms, ensuring optimal performance, schema governance, RMF control alignment, and full integration with the SDLC, DevSecOps, and application development teams.

The Senior DBA is responsible for database engineering, performance tuning, replication, failover strategies, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation while leading a technical team of database administrators. This role ensures the reliability, resilience, and security of mission-critical data systems across multiple environments.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level leadership over database operations, engineering, and administration in IL5 cloud and on-premise environments.
  • Oversee schema governance, indexing strategies, data modeling, and optimization for performance and scalability.
  • Ensure database platforms comply with DoD security requirements, RMF controls, STIG baselines, and audit readiness.
  • Lead performance tuning efforts, query optimization, and troubleshooting of complex database issues.
  • Manage backup, recovery, replication, clustering, and failover strategies to support high availability.
  • Coordinate with DevSecOps engineers on database integration within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support secure SDLC processes, including database change control and release planning.
  • Manage database access controls, permissions, service accounts, and privileged user oversight.
  • Oversee vulnerability scanning, patch planning, and remediation for database technologies.
  • Collaborate with application developers to align database design with business logic, data workflows, and mission requirements.
  • Maintain database documentation, ER diagrams, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks.
  • Lead and mentor a team of DBAs, ensuring adherence to best practices, consistent processes, and high operational readiness.
  • Provide technical input to modernization initiatives, cloud migration strategies, and new platform evaluations.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in database administration, engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing enterprise-class database systems in secure federal or DoD environments.
  • Experience implementing IL5 database security controls, RMF requirements, and STIG compliance.
  • Experience supporting SDLC integration, release cycles, and DevSecOps workflows.
  • Experience with performance tuning, complex queries, indexing, and database optimization.
  • Experience managing replication, clustering, failover, and backup/recovery operations.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong expertise with relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL).
  • Proficiency in database security, encryption, auditing, and privileged access management.
  • Knowledge of RMF, STIGs, IL5 cloud security controls, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, and DevSecOps concepts.
  • Experience with database monitoring tools, log analysis, and performance analytics.

Certifications

Required:

  • CompTIA Security+

Skills

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical and problem solving abilities, especially for complex data and performance issues.
  • Clear communication skills for working with developers, security teams, and federal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail with disciplined documentation and configuration management practices.
  • Ability to manage priorities across multiple environments in a mission-critical setting.
