data.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
data.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co-founder partnership with founder-level equity and founder-level authority, not a salaried executive role.

We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity.

This is a full-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You'll co-create with a proven venture building team, including:

  • John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR

  • Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits

  • Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold

  • Prathna Ramesh – Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor

The Partnership

  • Founder-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds

  • Founder-level authority, including co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes

  • Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner — building alongside you.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

  • Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against

  • Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call

  • Customer & Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly

  • Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team-building second

  • Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence

  • Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes

  • Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability

  • Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on

  • Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build

  • Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted

  • Prior experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus

  • Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Reporting into the Central Quality function and working within the SE Platform team, this role is uniquely positioned to drive the quality strategy across foundational platform areas that underpin our most critical innovations. 

What makes this role especially exciting: we’re not just building traditional apps. We’re accelerating delivery of advanced Cloud Engagements and moving toward Agentic development and testing capabilities—systems and harnesses that defy conventional testing and require a new way of thinking around test strategy, verification and validation.  

If you’re energized by the challenge of enabling velocity while maintaining trust and quality on an ever-evolving cloud ecosystem, this is the opportunity to shape that future.

  • Strong communication and coaching skills with the ability to influence fellow engineering and product stakeholders across the org. 

  • Foster a cross platform collaborative testing mindset to ensure quality flows through the Caseware Cloud Ecosystem 

  • Experience leading testing initiatives for distributed teams across multiple regions 

  • Experience in integrating QA tools like Zephyr Scale and on-prem CI/CD systems (GitHub) 

  • A strategic growth mindset paired with a desire to learn and mentor others with a pragmatic, system-thinking approach to quality at scale. 

  • Keen interest and knowledge of the latest industry trends in AI powered Testing tools like CoPilot, Devin and Claude will be a bonus.

data.title: Staff Security Researcher, Vulnerability Research (Emergent Threat Response & Me
data.description:
Rapid7's vulnerability intelligence team does industry-leading offensive research that helps organizations worldwide understand and prioritize real risk. When a critical vulnerability starts getting exploited in the wild, we're the team that figures out what's actually happening, how bad it is, and what defenders need to do about it. We're looking for an experienced vulnerability researcher to help lead that work, with a strong focus on rapid n-day analysis and on making Metasploit better for the security community.

About the Team

Rapid7 vulnerability researchers analyze high-priority n-day vulnerabilities, write Metasploit modules, find and publish zero-day vulnerabilities, and help customers, the media, internal teams, and the public understand which threats matter and why. We drive Rapid7's company-wide Emergent Threat Response (ETR) program, coordinating our research, product coverage, and customer guidance when widespread attacks hit. We aren't satisfied with being purely reactive, though. We also look for the vulnerabilities and attack patterns that will become tomorrow's widespread threats.

About the Role

This role sits at the Staff level, a senior technical leadership position on our individual contributor track. Your time will be focused primarily on Emergent Threat Response and Metasploit, with zero-day research as a secondary focus.


Primary focus: Emergent Threat Response (n-day research)

  • Rapidly analyze newly disclosed and actively exploited vulnerabilities, often under tight timelines, to determine root cause, exploitability, and real-world impact
  • Reproduce vulnerabilities and build working exploits from patch diffs, advisories, and limited public information, documenting behavioral differences across affected versions and platforms
  • Publish clear, technically rigorous root cause analyses that help defenders act quickly and reflect Rapid7's attacker-focused approach to vulnerability intelligence
  • Advise detection and vulnerability check engineers as they build coverage, and help internal teams and customers understand what's urgent, what isn't, and why
  • Serve as a go-to expert during high-velocity events (think Log4Shell), knowing when to raise alarms and when to counsel patience

Primary focus: Metasploit

  • Develop and contribute high-quality exploit modules to Metasploit, especially for high-priority vulnerabilities coming out of ETR work
  • Drive improvements to the Metasploit Framework itself, including new capabilities, tooling, library enhancements, and quality improvements that make the framework more effective for researchers and practitioners
  • Review community and internal module contributions, raising the bar for code qua
  • lity, reliability, and stability across the project
  • Partner with the Metasploit engineering team on roadmap priorities and help shape where the framework goes next

Secondary focus: Zero-day research

  • Identify and research, new vulnerabilities in technologies that matter to enterprise organizations
  • Help define longer-term research priorities with the broader team, bringing a point of view on emerging attack surface

Across all of it

  • Contribute technical trend analysis to Rapid7's research reports and publications
  • Represent the team's work through conference talks, webcasts, blog posts, and media engagements
  • Mentor and develop other researchers through code review, pairing, documentation, and technical guidance
  • Explain technical risk clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Demonstrable expertise across most major vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques, with the ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and attacks quickly and effectively
  • Experience developing complex exploit chains from scratch, including from patch diffs or minimal public detail
  • Strong reverse engineering and binary/code diffing skills, including against large codebases or binaries
  • Expert-level understanding of networking, operating system internals for one or more major OSes, and/or bypassing common exploit mitigations
  • A track record of writing about vulnerabilities and exploits for a public audience, and of speaking about your research at conferences, on webcasts, or similar venues
  • The ability to build custom tooling as needed and to scope work into clear milestones rather than monolithic deliverables
  • A willingness to mentor and teach. You don't need to be a people manager, but you should enjoy making the people around you better.
  • Communicate in a clear manner that conveys objectives and rationale when explaining complex attack patterns and risks to technical stakeholders and detection engineers.
  • Eager and open to understanding "why" a change is happening, acting as an active driver of it, and focusing forward versus in the past to tackle emerging threats.
  • Hold self and others responsible for driving outcomes and meeting commitments that deliver value for the business and our customers by establishing ownership within research projects.
  • Experience working cross-functionally during time-sensitive security events and translating technical findings for non-technical stakeholders
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

Nice to Have

  • Published zero-day vulnerabilities and CVEs
  • Prior contributions to the Metasploit Framework or other open source security projects
  • Media training or experience speaking with journalists
  • Experience applying AI or LLM-based tooling to accelerate vulnerability research or exploit development

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams, reflecting a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you're excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy. Apply today.

About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.

Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Business Development Engineer, USSOCOM to join the Applications Engineering team. This role is structured for early- to mid-career candidates seeking to bridge technical radio frequency capabilities with Special Operations Command customer requirements and emerging trends.

Reporting to the Director of Applications Engineering, you will work alongside Engineering and Business Development teams to support USSOCOM acquisition stakeholders and Component Commands. In this position, you will assist in demonstrating the technical capabilities, interoperability, low-signature performance, and field-readiness of our StreamCaster MANET radio portfolio across multi-domain, tactical edge, and uncrewed environments. This role requires up to 50% travel to customer sites, research laboratories, and strategic field-testing environments, with a 100% remote working option depending on location.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

data.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail
data.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart

  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed

  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate

  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you

  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up

  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need

  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors

  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something

  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app

  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning

  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"

  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on

  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself

  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead

  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data

  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)

  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there

  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/technical-co-founder-cto-ai-for-automotive-retail-futuresight

data.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • RTL Design: Design and implement digital blocks for PCS and interface IP (e.g. encoders/decoders, scramblers, PRBS generators/checkers, FIFOs, CDC logic, control and calibration state machines) in Verilog/SystemVerilog, under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Standards & Specifications: Study SerDes and UCIe standards and architecture documents, and help turn them into clear block-level specifications.
  • Verification: Build testbenches and run simulations to verify your designs, using SystemVerilog, UVM or cocotb, and help develop verification plans and coverage.
  • Mixed-Signal Modelling: Write behavioural models of analog blocks in Verilog/SystemVerilog (and Verilog-A where needed) to support mixed-signal and top-level simulation with the analog team.
  • Implementation Support: Gain exposure to synthesis, lint, CDC checks and static timing analysis, and learn how design choices affect power, performance and area.
  • Scripting & Automation: Use scripting (e.g. Python, TCL or shell) to automate simulation, regression and reporting flows.
  • Documentation & Process: Document your designs and test results clearly, and contribute ideas to improve our design and verification environments and procedures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with an experienced team of digital, analog and layout engineers across products such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of experience in digital design, including internships, placements or university projects
  • Solid understanding of digital logic fundamentals: synchronous design, finite state machines, timing, pipelining and clock-domain crossing
  • Hands-on experience writing RTL in Verilog or SystemVerilog, through coursework, thesis, FPGA or internship projects
  • Experience with an HDL simulator (e.g. Xcelium, VCS, Questa or open-source tools such as Verilator or Icarus)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail


Soft & Professional Skills:

  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

Nice-to-have:

  • Exposure to verification methodologies such as UVM, SystemVerilog assertions or cocotb
  • Basic knowledge of synthesis, static timing analysis or place-and-route
  • Familiarity with high-speed serial interfaces or protocols (e.g. UCIe, Ethernet, PCIe) or line coding (e.g. 8b/10b, 64b/66b)
  • Awareness of Design-for-Test concepts (scan, BIST) and hardware/software co-design
  • Scripting skills in Python, TCL or shell, and comfort in a Linux environment
  • FPGA prototyping experience


Soft & Professional Skills:

  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain your work concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.


OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!

  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.


WHY JOIN US

  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we'll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real digital and mixed-signal IP used in customer silicon, from your first months
  • Mentorship from day one – a dedicated manager and experienced engineers who will review your work and help you grow
  • Competitive, transparent compensation – adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – structured onboarding, AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective


RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview (90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min) – values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps – we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.


Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

data.description:
Headquarters: Missouri, United States
URL: http://www.crowdstrike.com

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do:

Technical Leadership:

  • Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters
  • Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations
  • Lead regional technical initiatives
  • Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support:

  • Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development
  • Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region.
  • Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance:

  • Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings
  • Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests
  • Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns
  • Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality
  • Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population
  • Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations.

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison

  • Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units
  • Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests
  • Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends
  • Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria
  • Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence.

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement

  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation

  • Provide Technical expertise on  regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals
  • Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities
  • Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities
  • Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact

Supervision & Autonomy

  • Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy
  • Works independently on technical matters
  • Expected to remain hands-on
  • Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives
  • Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership

What You'll Need

Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas:

  • Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries.
  • Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies.
  • Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise.
  • Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis.
  • Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas.
  • Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure.
  • Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data.
  • Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns.
  • Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains.
  • Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations.
  • Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination.
  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations.
  • Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities.
  • AI Platforms: Experience working across various AI models, platforms, and tooling including MCP servers and agentic frameworks. Applies AI broadly across security operations — from investigation acceleration and workflow automation to internal capability development, prompt engineering, and driving AI adoption and maturity across the team.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Education:
BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered.

data.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to help us build the next version of media web experience. In this role, you will define the work on the technical components of how we deliver video and audio content at Reddit. Specifically, you will focus on our web media player and the APIs that power it, drawing on industry patterns from top streaming platforms to build seamless, low-latency playback experiences and interactive tools for creators and users alike.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to execute on product and business strategy and build novel products and features that our users will love.
  • Contribute to the full development cycle: technical design, development, test, experimentation, analysis, and launch.
  • Design and implement end-to-end fullstack solutions, optimizing web UI components for our media player (React, TypeScript) and the backend APIs (Go, Python) that power them.
  • Move fast while balancing quality. We can’t afford extensive processes, and we also can’t afford show-stopping bugs.
  • You’ll be reviewing code and design docs, giving feedback on product specs and mocks.
  • Collaborate with client engineers and platform engineers to improve performance of media across Reddit to serve better content globally.
  • Contribute to standards that improve developer workflows, recommend best practices, and help mentor junior engineers on the team to grow their technical expertise.

Qualifications

  • BS degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of software development experience in one or more general-purpose programming languages; Go, Python, Rust, Ruby.
  • Proficiency in modern web development technologies (JavaScript, React, Next.js, TypeScript) and experience translating complex UI/UX designs into scalable web applications.
  • Experienced with GraphQL, REST, HTTP, gRPC, Thrift basics, and the ability to design and implement maintainable APIs.
  • Strong organizational skills, the ability to prioritize tasks and to deliver projects on schedule.

data.title: OCI Architect

experience_requirements.text: 10+ years of experience in customer-facing infrastructure or cloud architecture roles

data.description:
Centroid is Oracle Corporation's top Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) partner in North America, delivering architecture, implementation and modernization initiatives in OCI for our customers.
Our architects work directly alongside Centroid’s and client teams to design, migrate, and modernize mission-critical workloads- Oracle Databases, EBS, PeopleSoft, and next-generation AI/Data, Agentic AI, OCI genAI Platform solutions on OCI.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role. You will serve as the primary OCI architect on client engagements: owning solution design end-to-end, guiding technical decisions, and delivering production-grade implementations. No people management responsibilities.
As OCI Architect you will be engaging with various customers in their cloud enablement initiatives. The candidate will be involved in design and execution of cloud migration strategy, automating existing cloud workloads in cloud, provide services to port existing workloads to leverage cloud benefits.
Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in customer-facing infrastructure or cloud architecture roles
  • 5+ years of hands-on OCI design and implementation experience


Location: 100% Remote
Job Type: Full Time employee, CTH, or Contract

  • Architect end-to-end OCI solutions for customer engagements spanning landing zone design, network topology, identity, compute, storage, and database tiers
  • Lead Oracle Database workload migrations to OCI, including Exadata Cloud Service, Autonomous Database (ADB), and Base Database Service, with a focus on performance, HA, and DR
  • Design and execute Oracle Applications migrations (EBS, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards) to OCI, including lift-and-shift and modernization patterns
  • Architect and deploy AI/Data Platform (AIDP) workloads leveraging OCI GenAI Service, OCI AI Agents, OCI Data Science, and Oracle Database 23ai Vector Search
  • Develop and present technical architectures, reference designs, and migration runbooks for client pre-sales and delivery engagements
  • Build and maintain OCI landing zones using Terraform and OCI Resource Manager, aligned to Oracle's CIS Foundations Benchmark
  • Collaborate with Oracle technical teams (STCs, Cloud Engineers) on joint client engagements; serve as the technical point of escalation for Centroid
  • Define standards, reusable patterns, and architectural guardrails for Centroid's OCI delivery practice


Skills Preferred:
OCI Core Services

  • Compute: VM/BM shapes, Flex shapes, instances, autoscaling, instance configurations
  • Networking: VCN design, FastConnect, Site-to-Site VPN, DRG v2, Network Firewall, load balancers (L4/L7), DNS, Private DNS Resolver
  • Storage: Block Volume, File Storage (FSS), Object Storage (lifecycle, replication, versioning), Local NVMe
  • IAM: compartment hierarchy, policies, dynamic groups, federated identity (SAML/SCIM), OCI Vault, Bastion Service
  • Kubernetes: OKE cluster provisioning, node pool management, cluster networking (flannel/NPN), OCI Container Registry (OCIR)


Oracle Database & Exadata

  • Autonomous Database (ADB-S, ADB-D), Base Database Service, Exadata Cloud Service, Exadata Cloud@Customer
  • Data Guard (Maximum Availability, Maximum Performance), GoldenGate for live migration and zero-downtime cutovers
  • Oracle Database 23ai: JSON Relational Duality, True Cache, AI Vector Search, Select AI
  • Database migration tools: MV2ADB, Data Pump, ZDLRA, Database Migration Service (DMS)


Oracle Applications (Migrations to OCI)

  • EBS 12.1/12.2 on OCI: architecture patterns, shared file system design, wallet-based DB connectivity or similar Oracle Application experience, like Peoplesoft or JDE.


AI / GenAI / Data Platform

  • OCI Generative AI Service: Cohere and Meta model endpoints, embedding models, semantic search patterns
  • OCI AI Agents: agent frameworks, tool configuration, RAG pipelines, knowledge base integration
  • OCI Data Science: model deployment, JupyterLab environments, ML pipelines, Aqua (AI Quick Actions)
  • Oracle Database 23ai Vector Search: VECTOR data type, HNSW/IVF indexes, vector distance functions


Technical Skills — Preferred

  • Multi-cloud connectivity: OCI–Azure Interconnect, OCI–AWS, Oracle Database@Azure, Oracle Database@AWS
  • Oracle WebLogic Server on OCI / WebLogic for OKE
  • ZFS Storage Appliance on OCI, Oracle Linux, RHEL administration at scale
  • Observability: OCI Monitoring, Logging, Application Performance Monitoring (APM), OCI Ops Insights
  • FinOps: cost analysis, committed use discounts, OCI resource scheduling


Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate (1Z0-1072) - required within 90 days if not already held
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional (1Z0-997) - strongly preferred
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024 Generative AI Professional (1Z0-1127) - preferred
  • Oracle Exadata Database Machine Implementation Specialist - preferred for Exadata-focused engagements
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Lift projects


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent field - or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years total technical experience; 5+ years OCI-specific hands-on delivery


What Sets This Role Apart
You will work on OCI exclusively with ability to learn and engage with emerging technologies like multi-cloud architecture, Agentic AI and Generative AI. Centroid's clients engage us because of deep Oracle expertise, you will architect solutions that Oracle's own SCs reference, participate in Oracle partner programs, and shape how enterprise customers realize value from OCI's most advanced capabilities. If you are an OCI practitioner who wants to do the most technically demanding Oracle Cloud work available, this role is built for you.

data.title: Principal Platform Engineer, DevOps and Deployment (Regulated AI Software)
data.description:
ESQlabs is an innovative, internationally active Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a global leader in the development and application of the Open Systems Pharmacology (OSP) Suite. We combine mechanistic modeling, Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK) and Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP), with software and training to support Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) and Next-Generation Risk Assessment (NGRA) for pharmaceutical, chemical, and academic partners worldwide. Our mission is to empower life sciences: helping scientists understand mechanisms of disease and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized, safer, and more efficient treatment and testing strategies.

We are building a platform where AI agents help scientists set up regulated modeling analyses, and fixed, versioned procedures run them. This job is about the engine room: the compute core, the release pipeline and the operations.

About the role

You make sure our analyses can be reproduced, shipped to clients and checked later. You own the compute core, the release pipeline, deployment into client environments, and the metering and provenance behind every result. The AI layer has its own lead and team; you build what they run on. The Quality Manager sets the standards, you implement them. You report to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make the scientific compute core deterministic: pinned R, Python and solver toolchains, content-addressed container images with a software bill of materials, and tests that prove byte-identical re-execution on a reference platform and tolerance-bounded re-execution across platforms.

  • Build the services the AI layer runs on: isolated executors per client without network access, usage metering per call, the signed record and the certificate behind every result. You build the policy engine and the tool router together with the AI lead.

  • Expose the platform as a versioned API and as tools for AI agents with one shared contract, and ship the reproducibility package that re-executes a run outside the platform.

  • Run the evaluation pipeline in continuous integration: conformance tests against reference case sets, re-execution tests, regression tests, results stored per procedure version.

  • Own release engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, signed and content-addressed releases, scripted installation qualification, environment management (hosted, in a client tenant, later offline), monitoring, incident handling and the operating model the deployment engineer runs.

  • Implement the technical controls behind the information security and AI management standards the Quality Manager owns.


What you bring

  • At least five years of platform, infrastructure or backend engineering with senior ownership of a production system.

  • Reproducible builds and execution in practice: dependency pinning, artifact hashing, immutable versioning, supply chain integrity. Hermetic build systems are a strong plus.

  • Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator, monitoring, and release management for environments you don’t fully control.

  • API design where the schema was a contract with external consumers, including versioning and deprecation in practice.

  • Security engineering for multi-tenant systems: isolation, secrets, authorization, and awareness of the risks of language-model-driven systems. Exposure to GxP or equivalent regulated software is valuable; interest in acquiring it is required.

What's in store for you

The dynamic team behind ESQlabs unites people with different backgrounds, spanning disciplines like pharmaceutical sciences, physics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science, and software engineering. Our trust in each other, our open-mindedness, and our constant quest for excellence and innovation unite us. We value flat hierarchies, where everyone can contribute ideas and expertise to develop the best product. We are passionate, always willing to broaden our horizons, and love our start-up culture.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible work hours and a home office policy that focuses on people and not on numbers

  • An attractive remuneration package

  • Regular in-person team gatherings at locations across Europe.

  • A clearly defined technical problem with a commercial consequence, and the authority to solve it properly rather than quickly.

  • A working environment in which your contribution will make a difference, and that allows you to take ownership of projects and processes

  • A small, senior team that owns an open-source platform used by regulators and pharma, and the mandate to set the standard for certified scientific software.

  • Responsibility, autonomy, participation, and career perspective

About us

We collaborate with global corporations in the pharma and chemical industry, as well as start-ups in the life-science technology sector and academic and non-profit research institutions. We define new standards in pharmacometrics and systems pharmacology and toxicology areas. Our software and model platforms help scientists understand mechanisms of diseases and chemical toxicity to optimize individualized treatment of patients and protect the health of the animal and human life.

ESQlabs has attracted international players as sponsors for the OSP Software development. In addition, funding through national and EU-wide research grants allows us to develop our core technologies continuously.

For more information about our culture, values and benefits visit our Unique career opportunities - esqLABS GmbH.

ESQlabs is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, and value the diversity of perspectives this brings to our team.

This role will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to drive adoption, improve processes, and deliver scalable Salesforce solutions. The candidate must be comfortable supporting North American business operations and working EST/ET hours.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and related applications.
  • Configure and support custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, and permissions.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce Flows, approval processes, and automation solutions.
  • Manage user access, profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing rules.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business decision-making.
  • Perform data imports, exports, cleansing, deduplication, and data quality monitoring.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into Salesforce solutions.
  • Support integrations with external systems and third-party applications.
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and implement resolutions.
  • Participate in testing, release management, and deployment activities.
  • Ensure Salesforce best practices, governance, security, and compliance standards are followed.
  • Provide end-user training, documentation, and ongoing support.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Administration experience for Salesforce Administrator.
  • 5+ years of Salesforce Administration experience for Senior Salesforce Administrator.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform configuration and administration.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Salesforce Flows
    • Reports & Dashboards
    • Security Model and Permission Sets
    • Data Loader and Data Management Tools
    • Change Sets and Deployment Processes
    • Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Willingness to work EST/ET hours and collaborate with U.S.-based teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201).
  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator Certification.
  • Experience with CPQ, Experience Cloud, DocuSign, or Marketing Cloud.
  • Knowledge of Apex, SOQL, Lightning App Builder, and Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Familiarity with MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), or Azure Integration Services.

Key Skills

  • Security & Access Management
  • Data Management & Data Governance
  • Reporting & Analytics
  • User Training & Support
  • Release Management

data.description:
Job Title: Principal Cloud Solutions Architect – Azure Cloud

Location: US, Canada (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time

About Altera

Altera, a member of the N. Harris Computer Corporation family, delivers health IT solutions that support caregivers around the world. These include the Sunrise™, Paragon Daneli, TouchWorks EHR, Altera Opal, Ventus, HealthQuest™ and dbMotion™ solutions. At the intersection of technology and the human experience, Altera Digital Health is driving a new era of healthcare, in which innovation and expertise can elevate care delivery and inspire healthier communities across the globe. A new age in healthcare technology has just begun.

Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Principal Cloud Solutions Architect to join our Cloud Solutions Architecture team and drive the design of comprehensive, enterprise-grade solutions in Microsoft Azure. This role is highly client-facing and requires a strategic thinker who can bridge business needs with technical execution while partnering closely with development teams.

The ideal candidate is an expert in Azure architecture with deep experience across data platforms (including Databricks), cloud networking, identity and access management, and operational excellence. They will play a critical role in shaping solution strategy, guiding implementation, and ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, clients, and engineering teams to define and architect end-to-end cloud solutions aligned with strategic objectives
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing Azure architectures across multiple domains
  • Lead architecture for data and analytics platforms, including Azure Databricks and modern lakehouse patterns
  • Develop and enforce cloud networking strategies, including VNet design, hybrid connectivity, private endpoints, and secure access patterns
  • Define and implement Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks using Azure AD, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust principles
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure architectural alignment, best practices, and successful solution delivery
  • Drive operational excellence, including monitoring, logging, observability, resiliency, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Establish and promote architecture standards, governance frameworks, and design patterns across the organization
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on technical decision-making and trade-offs
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for clients and executive stakeholders
  • Mentor and guide engineers and junior architects to elevate overall cloud architecture maturity
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and continuously improve the organization’s cloud capabilities and innovation roadmap

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in IT, with at least 10 years focused on cloud architecture (Azure preferred)
  • Proven track record of working directly with clients and cross-functional development teams to deliver enterprise solutions
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure services, including compute, storage, security, and platform services
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and modern data architecture (data lakes, ETL/ELT, streaming, lakehouse)
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking (hub-and-spoke architectures, VPN/ExpressRoute, DNS, load balancing)
  • Extensive experience with Identity & Access Management, including Azure AD, RBAC, SSO, MFA, and Zero Trust frameworks
  • Experience designing for operational excellence, including monitoring, automation, incident response, and high availability
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and executive stakeholders
  • Experience delivering complex, multi-tier, distributed application architectures in a cloud environment

Core Competencies

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
  • Client-focused mindset with the ability to build trusted relationships and deliver solutions aligned to business goals
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions in complex environments
  • Highly organized and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Commitment to quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team culture

Travel

Up to 20% travel may be required for client meetings, project work, or team collaboration

Salary range: $140,000 - $170,000 USD. The salary range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education

data.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

ROLE: Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you.  

You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success. 

On a day to day basis, you will: 

  • Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated
  • Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results
  • Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub

This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement. 

THE SKILL SET

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years experience in a related role, Software (SaaS) experience is a plus
  • 2-3 years experience administering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Knowledge, Live Agent, and Customer Communities preferred
  • Salesforce Administrator certification is required
  • Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant certification is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience designing, revising and managing Salesforce Flows
  • Ability to lead teams through change management and business transformations
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to collaborate with management and others in the company
  • Disciplined, flexible, and autonomous work habits; we don't micromanage
  • Understanding of the SaaS business model and culture is a plus

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (https://salesloft.com/company/careers/).

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

data.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.

About the role:

Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.

The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.

What You’ll Do

  • Build reliability into the product. Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.
  • Build automation and platform tooling that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.
  • Lead technical design. Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.
  • Own the SLO framework. Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.
  • Improve observability and alerting so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.
  • Be on call for our highest-SLA customers. Act as a technical escalation point for complex customer environments. Lead customer-impacting incident response, including customer bridge calls when needed, and write blameless post-incident reviews that lead to engineering fixes.
  • Handle the operational work that comes from on-call. This includes investigating customer escalations, following up on incident actions, tuning capacity and configuration, and turning recurring issues into permanent fixes or automation.
  • Multiply the team. Mentor engineers, teach reliability practices that teams adopt early in development, and work with engineering leadership on roadmaps and product strategy.
  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)

On-Call

Weekday on-call is 12-hour shifts, Monday to Friday, split between North America and Europe so you cover your local working hours. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.
  • Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. You write clean, tested code and can make targeted changes in large open-source codebases you didn’t write.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems: performance, scaling and failure modes. You can reason about how a system will break before it does.
  • Experience running multi-tenant systems at scale on Kubernetes in AWS, GCP or Azure, with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Helm or Jsonnet.
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing SLOs.
  • Experience being on call for production systems. You troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure, and you’ve taken part in blameless incident response and written high-quality post-incident reviews.
  • Staff-level technical leadership: driving cross-team projects, setting technical direction and making the engineers around you better.
  • Working knowledge of Linux internals, networking and cloud storage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Prometheus or other observability and time-series databases.
  • Open-source contributions.
  • Customer reliability engineering (CRE) or customer-facing escalation experience.

In the UK, the Base compensation range for this role is £103,958 - £124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.#LI-Remote

#LI-Remote

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

data.title: Senior DevOps Consultant
data.description:
We are currently filling a Senior DevOps Consultant role at a leading provider of IT consulting, infrastructure and managed services in Austria.

In this position, you advise customers on the design, implementation and optimization of modern DevOps architectures and automation solutions. You analyze processes, identify potential and implement scalable CI/CD and cloud solutions, and act as the technical interface between development, operations and business departments.

We are looking for experienced DevOps Engineers or Consultants who bring solid knowledge of at least one programming language, classic DevOps principles, and automation and CI/CD.

| WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Advising customers on the design, implementation and optimization of modern DevOps architectures.
  • Analyzing existing development and operations processes to identify optimization potential.
  • Implementing and further developing scalable and secure CI/CD pipelines and cloud solutions, particularly in the Azure environment and with Kubernetes.
  • Acting as the technical interface between development, operations and business departments.
  • Contributing to the migration of on-premises applications to the cloud.
  • Introducing and establishing automation strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code, configuration management).
  • Conducting workshops and training for customers to convey DevOps best practices.
  • Ensuring the quality and monitoring of implemented DevOps solutions.

| WHOM WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Several years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer, Consultant or Cloud Engineer with solid knowledge of classic DevOps principles and methods.
  • Strong technology expertise in at least one programming language (C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Java) as well as practical experience with automation, CI/CD and modern software deployments, ideally with Azure and Kubernetes.
  • A structured, analytical way of working, strong consulting skills, and very good German and good English language skills, spoken and written.
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Jenkins, SAP connections and system integrations is an advantage.

| REMOTE WORK POLICY

In this role, you can work fully remote (within Austria).

Should you need to relocate or travel for this role, your relocation or travel costs will of course be covered.

| WHAT YOU WILL GET
